name: OPC UA
short_description: OPC Unified Architecture, an industrial communication standard for exchanging data in a structured information model, with typed values, status codes, client-server subscriptions and certificate-based application security.

evidence.quote: OPC Unified Architecture, or OPC. UA gives industrial systems a shared way to exchange data
Open platform communications Unified architecture is usually shortened to OPC. UA.
You might have a new packaging line with a modern PLC and an OPC UA interface
OPC-UA connects signals to industrial meaning.
The PLC raised the alarm, OPC UA is connected.
OPC UA provides machine data with structure and context.
It reads OPC UA data from several machines, applies a local data contract
An OPC-UA server exposes a signal, an edge gateway picks it up
OPC UA, open platform communications unified architecture, gives us a common way to access industrial data
